parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: DatabaseName
parameters.description: The name of the database that you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-database --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --database-name test01 --region cn-hangzhou
